name: P2 Knowledge Base Development
postCreateCommand: sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libleptonica6 libtesseract5 && LIBDIR=/usr/lib/$(dpkg-architecture -qDEB_HOST_MULTIARCH) && sudo ln -sf $LIBDIR/libleptonica.so.6 $LIBDIR/liblept.so.5 && sudo ldconfig; sudo mkdir -p /Users/stephen && sudo ln -sfn /opt/container-tools /Users/stephen/container-tools; pip install --user PyYAML && sudo unzip -q /tmp/devcontainer-bin/pnut-ts-linux-arm64-015107.zip -d /opt && sudo mv /opt/pnut-ts-linux-arm64-015107/pnut_ts /opt/pnut_ts && sudo rmdir /opt/pnut-ts-linux-arm64-015107 && sudo chmod +x /opt/pnut_ts/pnut-ts && sudo ln -sf /opt/pnut_ts/pnut_ts /usr/local/bin/pnut_ts
postStartCommand: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash && npm install -g @openai/codex && cp /tmp/devcontainer-bin/bash_aliases ~/.bash_aliases
